projects.name: Tempro
projects.problem: Where did my day actually go?
projects.caption: Time tracking that works out what you actually did.
projects.blurb: Automatic time tracking for Windows. It records the computer by itself, works out the project behind every window and answers for a day, a week or a whole year. Local and encrypted.

projects.name: Moonbow
projects.problem: I double-click a film, and then I wait.
projects.caption: A fast, quiet video and music player.
projects.blurb: A fast, quiet video and music player for Windows with a media library. Double-click, eight frames, the film is on. No ads, no account.

projects.name: V2pn
projects.problem: VPN clients are built for network engineers.
projects.caption: A simple VPN client. Pick a country, press Connect.
projects.blurb: A simple VPN client for your provider's servers, built on v2rayN. Pick a country and press Connect. VLESS, Hysteria2, Trojan and more.

projects.name: Claude Profile Switcher
projects.problem: Claude Desktop lets me into one account at a time.
projects.caption: Every Claude account open at once.
projects.blurb: Several Claude Desktop accounts on one Windows PC: each in its own window, all signed in at once, with every account's limits in view.

projects.name: Codex Switcher
projects.problem: Which Codex account still has limits left?
projects.caption: Every Codex account, limits in view.
projects.blurb: Several Codex accounts on one Windows PC: pick one and ChatGPT opens with it, the CLI and VS Code switch too, and every account's limits stay in view.

projects.name: earn›line
projects.problem: What did I actually earn this month?
projects.caption: A calm income ledger for independent work.
projects.blurb: A calm, local-first income ledger for independent work, built with SwiftUI. Your numbers stay on the phone.

projects.name: Cutoff
projects.problem: Preflop charts never stick in my head.
projects.caption: A calm trainer for tournament preflop decisions.
projects.blurb: A calm iPhone trainer for No-Limit Hold'em tournament preflop decisions: one decision per card, immediate feedback. For study only, no real money.

projects.name: Fount
projects.problem: What font is that site using?
projects.caption: The fonts behind any website, as clean TTF/OTF.
projects.blurb: Paste an address. Fount reads the page, groups what it finds into families and hands you clean TTF or OTF files. A local web app, a Chrome extension and a CLI on Rust and WebAssembly.

projects.name: Pinterest Plus Plus
projects.problem: Pinterest won't hand over the original file.
projects.caption: Save any pin in full quality.
projects.blurb: A free Chrome extension for Pinterest: download images and videos in original quality, copy pins as PNG and resize the grid. No tracking.

projects.name: Blackboard Text
projects.problem: I want to scribble over my own notes.
projects.caption: Notes you can draw over.
projects.blurb: A free, local-first notes app in the browser: write, then draw over your text. No account, works offline. A PWA and a Chrome and Edge extension.

projects.name: orvey
projects.problem: To make a picture I have to leave the chat.
projects.caption: Images and concepts, right inside the chat.
projects.blurb: Images and concepts right in Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and Codex: ask for a picture, get options, pick one, keep working. Every picture is kept in your own studio.

also.line: song lyrics on stage for Resolume
